reason: A DSH Web GUI plugin for real-time billing monitoring, including local token and cost tracking, balance alerts, official DeepSeek balance and pricing synchronization, persistent ledger storage, and an agent query tool.

summaries.zh: 用于 DSH Web GUI 的实时计费监控插件，可跟踪模型用量与估算费用、同步 DeepSeek 余额和价格，并提供余额告警与查询工具。
summaries.en: A real-time billing monitor for the DSH Web GUI that tracks model usage and estimated costs, synchronizes DeepSeek balances and prices, and provides balance alerts and a query tool.

capabilities: Monitors local DSH model usage and estimated costs
Persists billing configuration, usage counters, and transaction ledger to a workspace JSON file
Calls the DeepSeek balance and pricing endpoints when configured
Stores a DeepSeek API key in the local ledger file
Provides a billing_balance agent tool for querying balance and usage details
